govdocs-archive_org-kalevala-the-land-of: Elias Lönnrot’s Kalevala, Volume 2 continues Finland’s great national epic — the land of heroes. The ancient runes sing of Väinämöinen and his kin. Tolkien loved these tales. The Sampo’s forging shines here. The book is the crown of Finnish literature.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-CBSPart2_CBS_Pa: Harold Weisberg’s letter to George Herman of CBS News — March, year unclear — is a researcher’s note to the broadcaster. The file belongs to the assassination archive. Weisberg pressed the networks on the JFK case. The item is a fragment of correspondence.
the-pillars-of-the-house-or-under-wode-u: Charlotte Yonge's long family saga follows the thirteen Underwood children after they lose both parents. The eldest son, barely grown himself, must hold the household together while his brothers and sisters stumble through school, work, and young love. First published in 1873, the novel mixes Victorian moral lessons with genuine warmth for its huge, quarrelsome, loving family.
theological-essays-and-other-papers-volu: The second volume of De Quincey's religious writings gathers his meditations on scripture, miracles, and the mysteries of faith. His ornate, musical prose turns even doctrine into literature. Readers who know him only as the opium-eater will find here a deeply serious — if unconventional — religious thinker.
sunny-memories-of-foreign-lands-volume-2: Harriet Beecher Stowe continues her European travel memoir, recording her encounters with the famous and the sights of the Old World. The author of Uncle Tom's Cabin was lionized abroad, and her sunny observations charmed readers at home. A delightful Victorian travelogue.
old-mortality-volume-2: Scott's tale of the Covenanters goes on as Henry Morton steers between love and duty in a land torn by warring faiths. The clash of zealots unfolds with Scott's broad human pity. One of the Waverley Novels' most stirring works of history.
the-heart-of-mid-lothian-volume-2: Jeanie Deans's pilgrimage reaches its climax in this second volume, as her simple truthfulness confronts power in high places. Scott's heroine remains one of fiction's noblest creations. The moving conclusion of a beloved masterpiece. Her integrity shines all the brighter against the corruption she faces.
life-of-her-most-gracious-majesty-the-qu: Sarah Tytler continues her life of Queen Victoria through the middle years of the reign — the empire at its height and the queen in her long mourning. This second volume covers the Victorian age at its zenith. Devoted, detailed biography in the grand old manner.
the-land-of-midian-revisited-volume-2: Burton's Midian expedition continues through desert wadis and ancient ruins in this second volume. His account of the search for gold and history is rich in adventure and erudition. A fitting close to a bold journey. Gold-seekers' hopes and explorers' hardships color every page of this desert adventure.
the-great-conspiracy-volume-2: Logan's history continues through the war's first campaigns, as North and South gird for the long fight. Bull Run, the border states, and the making of armies fill these pages. A Union general's vivid account of 1861. Marching songs, new flags, and the first blood of a long war fill a narrative written by one who helped direct it.
cecilia-or-memoirs-of-an-heiress-volume-: Fanny Burney's Cecilia continues as the young heiress navigates London's fashionable dangers — fortune-hunters, false friends, and the pride that threatens her happiness. This second volume deepens the comedy and the feeling. Burney at her sparkling best. Balls, beaux, and bad advisers test her judgment in chapters sparkling with Burney's wit.
the-prince-and-the-pauper-part-2: The prince in rags and the pauper in silk stumble through London's extremes in this second part. Twain contrasts palace and gutter with growing power. Adventure and moral force in equal measure. Twain's England, rich and rotten by turns, unfolds through their amazed young eyes.
handy-andy-a-tale-of-irish-life-volume-2: Samuel Lover's Handy Andy continues his blundering, big-hearted way through Irish life in this second volume. The most famous Irish comic novel, full of bulls, blunders, and laughter. Lover at his rollicking best. His Irish bulls and blunders have kept readers laughing for generations.
the-adventures-of-tom-sawyer-part-2: Tom Sawyer's adventures continue as the boys witness the murder in the graveyard and take their oath of silence. Twain's second part deepens the thrill — Injun Joe stalks these chapters. Boyhood adventure at its most exciting. The midnight oath binds them as Injun Joe's shadow darkens St. Petersburg.
a-connecticut-yankee-in-king-arthur-s-co: Hank saves himself with an eclipse and becomes the Boss in this second part. His first miracles of Yankee ingenuity dazzle the court. Twain's comedy of anachronism hits its stride. An eclipse, a bonfire, and a fountain restore his prestige in fine style.
a-book-of-old-ballads-volume-2: Volume two of the old ballads — Scottish chiefs, English bowmen, and star-crossed lovers — carries on Nichols' lively anthology. The past sings again in his spirited and faithful versions. A treasure for all ballad lovers. The old north country lives in every stanza.

cia-crest-cia-rdp10m02313r000704040004-2: A once-secret Carter White House order, PD/NSC-55, kept in CIA files and freed through CREST. This paper holds a presidential order with thin listed details. A scrap of late-1970s security policy, now open to all who dig through the archive.
cia-crest-cia-rdp13x00001r000100380001-2: OSS letters from 1941, the agency's first full year of war. This plain CREST file holds the young outfit's mail: orders, queries, and office chatter. cia-crest-cia-rdp13x00001r000100410007-2: OSS field notes on life behind enemy lines, an author index of field reporting, and a 1944 Serbia visit account. This CREST bundle brings the war's ground truth. Spies writing home from danger zones, in their own words. The war as the field agents saw it.
cia-crest-cia-rdp33-02415a000100030022-2: Declassified briefing notes once prepared for the CIA Director himself. cia-crest-cia-rdp33-02415a000100140002-2: A declassified operational summary of the Air Weather Reconnaissance Squadron, Provisional (III), under the Operations Directorate. cia-crest-cia-rdp33-02415a000200010014-2: An untitled declassified CIA document from the U-2 program collection. This CREST page keeps its subject to itself. A stray sheet from the AQUATONE archive, nameless but preserved. A page that says nothing out loud yet says it was there.
cia-crest-cia-rdp33-02415a000200190006-2: A declassified CIA table of contents from the U-2 program files. This CREST page lists what a larger secret document once held. cia-crest-cia-rdp33-02415a000200210003-2: A declassified summary of a 1956 weapons system management meeting at Offutt Air Force Base. cia-crest-cia-rdp33-02415a000200300049-2: A declassified two-month report from a CIA supply depot covering June to July 1969. cia-crest-cia-rdp33-02415a000300150036-2: A declassified monthly commander's report for April 1962 from the U-2 program. This CREST record logs a month of high-altitude spying. cia-crest-cia-rdp33-02415a000300150054-2: Yet another declassified monthly commander's report from the U-2 program files. This CREST document keeps the commander's chronicle going strong.
